captions.detailed: This 3D model features a realistic amateur astronomical telescope mounted on a sturdy tripod. The main optical tube is colored white with a blue front lens and black rear eyepiece assembly, supported by a detailed black mounting head with adjustment dials. The tripod consists of three dark-colored upper legs with adjustable silver metallic extensions and small black rubber feet, connected by a central spreader plate with stabilizing rods. The telescope tube is designed to pivot vertically (elevation) while the mount head rotates horizontally (azimuth) on top of the tripod.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed 3D model of an astronomical telescope on a tripod. It should feature a white cylindrical optical tube with a blue lens, a black mounting head with fine-adjustment details, and a three-legged adjustable tripod with silver extension sections and a central spreader tray. Ensure the telescope tube can rotate vertically and the mount can rotate horizontally relative to the tripod.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject framework. The tripod base is constructed from a central hub cylinder, three angled cylinder legs with nested inner metallic cylinders, and a bottom spreader tray. The azimuth mount is placed on top using cylinders and a decorative dial plate. On top of this, a u-shaped bracket holds the elevation assembly, which consists of a long main cylinder for the white optical tube, a smaller finder scope cylinder, a blue circular lens face, and a rear eyepiece cylinder. Revolute joints are modeled for the azimuth rotation and the elevation tilt.
